name: lekh
description:
Lekh is a collaborative diagramming and whiteboarding app. Connect it to ChatGPT to draw diagrams from a description — flowcharts, sequence diagrams, network and cloud architecture diagrams, mind maps, ER diagrams, org charts and more — using Lekh's catalogue of over 4,600 shapes, including AWS, Azure and Google Cloud icons. ChatGPT can also read, render and explain your existing boards, edit them (including while a colleague has the board open), organise boards into folders, and share them.

Who it is for: anyone with a Lekh account who wants a diagram drawn or changed by asking for it.

Limitations: you need a Lekh account; boards larger than 1 MB or 50 pages cannot be opened by the connector; renders use a standard font rather than the board's own; the connector does not see edits made by others until it reads the board again.

defaultPrompt: Draw a flowchart of our user sign-up process in Lekh
Make a sequence diagram of a login flow on a new Lekh board
Summarise what my Lekh board 'Architecture' shows

review.commerce_description: Lekh's connector does not sell anything or process payments.

positive.description: Draw a flowchart from a description
positive.prompt: Create a new Lekh board called "Sign-up flow" with a flowchart: visitor opens the site, enters email, receives a code, enters the code, account created; show a branch for a wrong code.
positive.expected_behavior: A new board named "Sign-up flow" exists with the steps and the wrong-code branch connected in order. ChatGPT shows a rendered image and confirms before writing (destructive prompt).

positive.prompt: What does my Lekh board "Architecture" show?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the sample board, describes its components and connections accurately, and shows a picture of it. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: On my Lekh board "Onboarding flow", add a step "Send welcome email" after "Account created".
positive.expected_behavior: The new step is added and connected after "Account created"; other shapes are unchanged; a render shows the result.

positive.prompt: Make a folder "Q4 planning" in Lekh and move the board "Roadmap" into it.

positive.description: Find a cloud shape and draw with it
positive.prompt: In Lekh, draw a small AWS diagram: users → CloudFront → S3 bucket.
positive.expected_behavior: A board with the three AWS icons connected left to right, using AWS shapes rather than plain boxes.

negative.description: Unrelated request. Expected: Lekh tools are not called; ChatGPT answers without the plugin or says Lekh can't help.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?

negative.description: Payment request. Expected: no tool is called. The connector has no purchase capability, and ChatGPT says so without promoting a plan.
Access to someone else's board. Expected: the call fails with Lekh's not-found / no-access error; nothing is deleted; ChatGPT reports it cannot access that board.
negative.prompt: Open the Lekh board with id doc-not-mine and delete it.

publication.release_notes: First directory release of the Lekh connector: create, read, render, edit, organise and share Lekh boards.
